baseline: v0.45.1 is the known stable recovery baseline; reconciled v0.46.0 build 2026.08.24.2 is the verified functional donor. Failed later v0.46 presentation experiments are excluded.
implemented_this_release: New mockup-authoritative desktop shell and Dashboard visual system isolated in assets/desktop-v047.css
Shared desktop geometry with controlled gaps, compact information density, real SVG icon sizing contracts, and no generic SVG sizing rules
Desktop Dashboard regions: Today’s Status, Next Up, Quick Actions, Recent Activity, ZEKE Insights, Health at a Glance, Timeline Snapshot, Goals, and contextual Quick Tip
Separate mobile Dashboard continuity path preserves the proven v0.46 mobile composition rather than forcing desktop layout onto phone widths
Weekly workout planning preserved in Fitness rather than occupying the desktop Dashboard

All verified v0.45.1/v0.46 behavior retained, including adaptive workout proposals/remaining-workout adaptation, document intake, medication/calendar privacy, Talk state controls, Questions feedback, anatomy/body-area relationships, browse-first exercise navigation, and variation-aware charts
Documents navigation repaired so the Documents route cannot fall back to Dashboard
Actual Chromium visual gates added for multi-width Dashboard geometry, major desktop/mobile routes, oversized-SVG regression, and sparse/normal/dense/long-text adversarial states
inherited_verified_evidence: v0.25.2 direct mobile workout save handler and visible failure path
deterministic medication, sleep, workbook, provenance, and workflow regressions
known_issues: Live Google Drive/Calendar/provider and connected-AI behavior still requires the deployed authorized environment; package-local tests cannot prove third-party availability.
Browser PDF/OCR extraction uses lazy third-party CDN modules and requires network availability when those extraction paths are used.
The local anatomy/reference pack has version/review/staleness metadata; a mature externally refreshed/signed source-update pipeline remains future work.
Calendar write privacy choices are stored; future exposed sensitive writes must continue to honor staged/per-event consent.
